answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 327 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the timber funding graph is rebuilt from the violet history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 327 bonds yet holds one position, and the haven report publishes the merged exposure. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
